opportunities.name: Trip.com attractions search by city and keyword
opportunities.description: On Trip.com Attractions & Tickets, search a {city} for {keyword}, sort the results by {sort_order}, and open a result.
steps: Click the 'City or Region' field, type {city} and pick it from the suggestions
Click the {sort_order} sort tab (Top Rated or Lowest Price)
Open the chosen result to see its details

opportunities.name: KOA campground search
opportunities.description: On koa.com, search for campgrounds near {destination}, with optional filters such as {stay_type} and optional {check_in}/{check_out} dates.
steps: Optionally open Filters and tick the {stay_type} checkbox (e.g. RV Site)
Type {destination} in 'WHERE DO YOU WANT TO GO?' and pick a suggestion
Optionally click CHECK IN, move to the month you want and pick {check_in}
Optionally click CHECK OUT and pick {check_out}
